question_text:
A 24-year-old man with type 1 diabetes mellitus is brought to the emergency department because of weakness, abdominal pain, nausea, and one episode of vomiting for 1 day. He has not taken his insulin for 3 days. His pulse is 125/min and respirations are 29/min. Examination shows dry mucous membranes. His breath has a fruity odor. Which of the following sets of laboratory values is most likely on evaluation of urine obtained before treatment?
 $$$ pH %%% HCO3- %%% NH4+ %%% K+ $$$?
